headless.scope: The 36 ESM modules close the original four tests plus solo-game and grenade-controls. app.js is an intentional harness script resource, not a closed browser/ESM application entry. Node VM is test behavior, not importer behavior.

liveFieldView.scope: Actual Farmyard grenade trajectory and transient visual hooks; its full browser, actor and art dependency closure is not imported.

references.motionBoundary: The generic designer throw accepts a caller-owned worker rig and grenade prop; grenade.id must be grenade. It resets root transforms/pose and may use optional preparedBalance or iterative balance. Animal-specific rigs, bone names, wing handling and caller lifetime remain required. Designer presenter also uses hen-grenade-throw. None is invoked by the live FieldView; its illustrative bounce/physics is not Farmyard authoritative gameplay.

dynamicResources.policy: No binary assets copied. Git blob IDs/bytes identify unimported resources; SHA-256 is included only where computed. These lists bound the named URL/data constructions, not a complete live-app or caller-owned rig resource closure.

dependencyResolutions.gamePolicy: Missions, cast, scheduling, visibility, storage, windows, fuel and fire stay reference-only. A separate engine-owned runtime must expose its supported profile and reject unsupported host facts before costs.

behavior.claim: Base grenade cost 5 AP; equipped pistol, pistol-offhand or SMG discounts to 2.5. Accepted command consumes one grenade and synchronizes pack rounds while retaining the equipped weapon. Failed preview spends nothing. Eligibility precedes possible exploration-to-combat AP refresh; no living guards means no refresh.

Range 10 m, blast 5 m; trajectory uses 33 sinusoidal samples. Explored landing, in-bounds, obstacle, air-path and AP checks are distinct from blast lineClear. Footprint is fog-limited, not a visibility reveal.

Blast resolves during the accepted command, visits living units in source order including self/allies, applies falloff/resistance and ordinary casualty consequences once. Conditional loaded-fuel detonation may replace damage, consume saved RNG, alter later victims and break windows before the ordinary post-loop windowBlast. These are ordered authoritative consequences, not cosmetic callbacks.
Surviving guards within 20 m of the thrower become alert and remember the thrower. This is a game alert policy, not an acoustic simulation.

Fuel blast radius 5 breaks windows ignoring walls, destroys carried fuel/pack/slot state, lights eligible ground cells for 3 turns, kills in the 3 m same-height square and ignites radius-5 units. Source save restore checks destroyed-tank consistency. Fire, windows and geometry stay explicit host consequence boundaries.

App aim/cancel is free; commit rechecks the landing, calls actual Core.throwGrenade, ends camera aim with 800 ms linger and saves. Original input/button tests use the actual app script with view/art stubs.

Live FieldView presents sampled line/ring effects on a 700 ms lifetime and delayed grenade window visuals; it does not call the designer body throw driver. This is transient playback of an already resolved command.

encodeSave omits effect, fireAnimations and windowEvents. Spent AP/stock, HP/casualties, fuel/fire/window changes persist; there is no authoritative fuse, bounce or saved midflight projectile to resume.

rights.status: Original bytes, embedded comments, upstream provenance and the two Three MIT notices are retained. No root license is present at this pin. Provenance is not an additional license grant.

adaptations: None in original payload. Generated private ESM package.json makes preserved .js conformance modules directly runnable under Node. Public runtime/adapters and packaging decisions are separate.

designEvaluation.accuracy: Prefer exact source semantics for Farmyard-compatible tactical comparison; sinusoidal paths and planar blast cover are approximations, not measured ballistics or shrapnel.
designEvaluation.efficiency: Measured raw copied payload and static dependency/resource sizes only. Headless evidence avoids renderer/art copying; no CPU, memory or mobile performance claim.
designEvaluation.narrative: Keep Farmyard controls/outcome rules for compatibility. Other games choose explicit adapters. Richer fuel/fire belongs to a declared ordered reactive profile.
